actual_checks.check: Read AGENTS.md, current development summary, complete guide/generator/data, SVG elements, three relevant member rows/raw end-datum groups, eight receiver occurrences, four current axes and saved left-leg recess definition.
SHA-256 verification of seven targets and eight data-bound inputs; first three target hashes match delegated frozen authority.
Independent standard-library arithmetic from source CSV world vertices: L=dot(world-datum,basis_L), W=-dot(world-datum,basis_V), and unit/orthogonal bases.
Current JSON receiver census vs guide table.
Four current axis points/directions match data; eight local receiver centers independently recomputed; entry/exit travel intervals contiguous in -X.
Independent cut-angle arithmetic atan2(long-edge offset,139.7) and distances from source edge/world coordinates, checked against 0.001-mm / 0.001-degree guide rounding.
Independently project heel B onto recess grain direction; subtract this global origin from source taper endpoints; confirm both lower holes fall below full-depth endpoint.

Parse each physical SVG with ElementTree independently of generator: width 190mm, height 260mm, viewBox 0 0 190 260, 1 mm/unit, two 100-mm scale checks. Check all six target circles and three red end lines from independently recomputed source positions within serialized 0.0001-mm precision.

Independently invert overview world-YZ projection for four target circles. Manually confirm raw profiles, face handedness and schematic member order: outer left-leg sheet faces -X, inner runner sheet faces +X, lower runner/leg and upper side/leg drilling proceed toward -X.

Guide claim/operation review: owner pull-saw/handheld-drill/clamp policy, left-only sheets, outer-face raw leg outlines, explicit incomplete recess method, separate nominal bolt length/drill travel, unverified bit/tolerance/tool/fixture/access/physical fit and strength boundaries are preserved.

commands: Read-only cat/nl/sed/head and sha256sum on AGENTS.md and owned review targets/sources.

One inline .venv/bin/python -B standard-library review script read CSV/JSON/XML and independently checked transforms, cut angles, spacings, recess origin, axis/receiver intervals and SVG coordinates. It did not import the drawing helper or run its --check.
Final .venv/bin/python -B script rehashed targets and wrote only this permitted ignored receipt.
limitations: This is saved-coordinate correctness review within the nominal proposal scope, not engineering acceptance, fabrication release or physical observation.
No CAD import/rebuild, native mechanics, global solve, full suite, web lookup, geometry change, bit/tolerance selection, fixture qualification, printing or physical trial performed.
Generator --check is owned by the separate testing reviewer and was not duplicated.
Visual rendering/presentation and physical printer/tool results are outside these independent source-coordinate checks.
scope: Read-only independent correctness review of frozen guide, saved-coordinate generator/data, and four SVGs. No shared edits.
